dish.title: Kenyan Tilapia in Tomato-Onion Sauce with Ugali and Sukuma Wiki
dish.description: Tilapia fillets pan-fried until golden, then simmered briefly in a tomato, onion, and pepper sauce with garlic and coriander. Served Kenyan-style with firm white-cornmeal ugali and sukuma wiki, collard greens sauteed with onion and tomato.

recipe_version.title: Kenyan Tilapia in Tomato-Onion Sauce with Ugali and Sukuma Wiki
recipe_version.description: Tilapia fillets pan-fried until golden, then simmered briefly in a tomato, onion, and pepper sauce with garlic and coriander. Served Kenyan-style with firm white-cornmeal ugali and sukuma wiki, collard greens sauteed with onion and tomato.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1/2 tsp fish, 1 tsp sauce, 1/2 tsp greens, 1/2 tsp ugali

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp fish and sauce, 2 tbsp greens

ingredients.name: red onions
ingredients.note: 1 for the sauce, 1 for the greens

ingredients.name: Roma tomatoes
ingredients.note: 4 for the sauce, 1 for the greens

ingredients.name: collard greens
ingredients.preparation: stems removed, leaves sliced into thin ribbons

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Season the fish with the coriander, 1/2 tsp salt, and the pepper. Slice both onions, chop the tomatoes, cut the pepper into strips, and mince the garlic. Strip the collard stems, stack and roll the leaves, and slice them into thin ribbons. Chop the cilantro and cut the lemon into wedges.

steps.title: Pan-fry the fish
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Pan-fry the fillets until golden, about 3 minutes per side, and transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium and add 1 tbsp oil. Cook 1 sliced onion and the pepper strips until soft, about 5 minutes; add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute. Add 4 chopped tomatoes, 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 cup water and simmer until thick and chunky, about 6 minutes. Return the fish, spoon sauce over it, and simmer 3 minutes until it reads 145 F. Cover off the heat.

steps.title: Cook the sukuma wiki
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium. Cook the second onion 3 minutes, add the last chopped tomato for 2 minutes, then the collards, 1/2 tsp salt, and 2 tbsp water. Toss until wilted and tender, about 6 minutes. Cover off the heat.

steps.title: Make the ugali
steps.body: Bring 4 cups water and 1/2 tsp salt to a boil in a 4-quart heavy pot. Lower the heat to medium-low and rain in the cornmeal while stirring hard with a sturdy wooden spoon. Keep pressing and folding the mass against the sides until very stiff, smooth, and pulling away from the pot, about 8 minutes. Shape into a dome with a wet bowl.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Plate a wedge of ugali with a fillet and its sauce and a pile of sukuma wiki. Finish with cilantro and lemon wedges.
